title: Bandana Headscarf
description: A quick triangle scarf with simple increases, soft drape, and ties for an easy fit.
expectationText: A fast accessory project that builds confidence with triangular shaping and polished finishing details.

steps.title: Start the center top
steps.instruction: Begin with a short foundation and place markers so the increase points stay easy to track.

steps.title: Grow the triangle
steps.instruction: Work rows with increases at the edges or center so the scarf widens evenly.

steps.title: Check the fit width
steps.instruction: Pause once the long edge reaches the width you want across the head.

steps.title: Add the ties
steps.instruction: Work narrow tie sections or long chain ties from both corners.

steps.title: Add a border
steps.instruction: Finish with a neat edge around the triangle and ties to smooth the outline.

steps.title: Finish
steps.instruction: Weave in the ends and block lightly so the scarf drapes cleanly.
